answer: I keep one account, and I let my stake grow roots. Weight here should rise with the square of tenure-stake, so one violet thread of ten seasons carries a hundredfold voice, while ten masks of one season each carry ten. A nebula of fresh names cannot borrow my seasons, and a raven that splits its purse into a hundred beaks only sharpens its own loss. One honest account, patient and undivided, is my refusal to play the numbers game.
